description: About The Opportunity As a Data Analyst you will enable our product and business segments in the Customer Identity to make data-driven decisions. You will monitor, measure and analyse the effectiveness of your product teams’ initiatives, as well as help drive the strategy of your business segment. You are here to establish a data-mindset and thereby to foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement. You will work in a cross functional setup, working closely with other analysts, engineers, designers, and product managers. In This Role, You Will Help us set the right goals: Develop clear and measurable targets based on an initiatives’ scope. Improve our overall forecasting and goal setting capabilities. Handle stakeholders: Be an internal go-to-person for your teams when it comes to data related questions. Evaluate initiatives: Support Product experimentation & testing initiatives; design test plans, obtain cross-functional alignment, execute robust analysis, and deliver actionable insights. Share these learnings through clear documentation and concise and empathic communication. Contribute to self-serve data platform: Help building the right analytics foundations ,by pairing up with technical peers, so our product teams can interact with data and extract the right insights themselves. Provide monitoring tools: Build the dashboards your team looks at every week to make sure they are impacting our company OKRs. Improve data literacy of organisation: Educate teams to become independent when it comes to data access and understanding function led training and team wide workshops to foster data driven culture. Be part of our data-community: Collaborate with a broad range of analytics teams at N26 to utilise shared platforms, insights and innovations. Support some of the following product & business team initiatives (not limited to): You support your team in discovery of new product ideas, identifying user friction points and business opportunities. Evaluate your teams’ continuous releases making sure they are delivering on business goals via experimental or observational methods. Collaborate with UX researchers to combine qualitative and quantitative research for better product hypotheses. During product development you make sure all data needed for future evaluation is being captured through set up of tracking events or as part of the backend service. Drive the quantitative analysis on your segment, being responsible for the insights and business discovery on the team. Background What you need to be successful: 1+ years of experience, ideally within the Product or Analytics field. Skills Strong understanding of statistical methods used in the analysis of experimental and observational data. Highly experienced with SQL and Python/R for analytics Strong understanding of experimentation methods (e.g. A/B testing) Experience working with one or more common data visualisation tools (Tableau, Metabase, Looker, Superset, etc) Good presentation skills and communication skills. Having experience in high growth startups managing topics like customer identity/KYC would be a plus Having experience in quantitative research would be a plus. Having experience in fintech would be a plus. Having familiarity with LLM conversational BI is a plus What’s In It For You Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀. Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation. As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members. Additional day of annual leave for each year of service. A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds. A relocation package with visa support for those who need it. Who we are N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use. We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.Sounds good? Apply now for this position. Do you see yourself thriving in this role? We’d love to see your application even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles! Equal opportunities for all At N26, we believe our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring. We strive to build diverse teams that drive innovation and business success. We actively seek talent from all backgrounds and welcome applications from all genders, cultures, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages.We are committed to providing an excellent and accessible candidate experience. If you require any accommodations to make this process work for you, please let us know. We’re here to support you!Discover more about Diversity & Inclusion at N26: https://n26.com/en-eu/diversity-and-inclusion

description: Job description: Job Description Role Summary We are seeking an experienced Agile Product Owner to lead the development of our AI platform. This role will work closely with engineering and AI/ML teams to define product vision, translate business needs into technical requirements, and drive execution in an agile environment. The ideal candidate combines strong product thinking, technical fluency in AI systems, and stakeholder management skills. ͏ Key Responsibilities (JD Points) Define Product Vision & Strategy Own the roadmap for the AI platform, aligning business goals with technical capabilities and market needs. Translate Requirements into Execution Convert business use cases into detailed product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for engineering and AI teams. Collaborate Across Teams Act as the bridge between data scientists, ML engineers, software engineers, and business stakeholders to ensure clarity and alignment. Drive Agile Delivery Manage backlog, prioritize features, and participate in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives to ensure timely delivery. Monitor Product Performance Define success metrics, track model and platform performance, and continuously iterate based on data and feedback. ͏ Required Capabilities (Top 5 Skills) Strong Agile Product Ownership Proven experience working as a Product Owner in Agile/Scrum environments with end-to-end ownership of product delivery. AI/ML Understanding Solid understanding of AI/ML concepts (model lifecycle, training, evaluation, deployment, data pipelines). Technical Fluency Ability to work closely with engineering teams—understanding APIs, system architecture, and platform design. Stakeholder Management Excellent communication skills to align cross-functional teams and manage competing priorities. Data-Driven Decision Making Ability to define KPIs, interpret data insights, and drive product decisions using analytics. ͏ ͏ Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end-to-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA - as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention. Come to Wipro. Realize your ambitions. Applications from people with disabilities are explicitly welcome.
title: CTO - AI/ML Product Owner

description: baue nicht nur Produkte, sondern die Strukturen dahinter Du suchst keine Rolle, in der du Backlogs verwaltest und Roadmaps pflegst, die andere längst entschieden haben? Gut. Denn hier geht es nicht um Verwaltung - sondern um Professionalisierung. Wir suchen einen Product Manager (Mid–Senior), der hands-on am Produkt arbeitet: Discovery selbst durchführt, mit Kunden spricht, Business Cases kalkuliert, Anforderungen schreibt und die Umsetzung mit der IT begleitet. Jemanden, der nicht auf perfekte Prozesse wartet, sondern sie selbst mitgestaltet. Wer wir sind & wo wir stehen Wir sind eine junge Unternehmensgruppe (30+ Personen) an der Schnittstelle von Legal, Legal Tech und Tech. Unter unserem Dach arbeiten eine etablierte B2B-SaaS-Plattform im Legaltech-Bereich, eine eigenständige Kanzlei, ein Datenschutz-Consulting und eine neu gegründete IT-GmbH. Unsere Plattform gibt es schon eine ganze Weile. Sie gliedert sich in einen kostenlosen Bereich und einen Premium-Bereich und umfasst zahlreiche Generatoren und Features, die historisch gewachsen sind und aktuell Schritt für Schritt erneuert und optimiert werden. Wir haben funktionierende Produkte, eine breite zahlende Nutzerbasis und laufende Projekte. Was noch fehlt: ein professionalisiertes, zahlenbasiertes Produktvorgehen, eine klare Produktstrategie, die gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung getragen wird, und ein sauber aufgebauter Product-Tribe. Es gibt Substanz - aber noch kein professionalisiertes System. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Du steigst nicht in eine bestehende Produktorganisation ein, du baust sie mit auf - und bleibst dabei hands-on am Produkt. Dein Impact wird direkt sichtbar: in Produkten, Prozessen und Zahlen. Aufgaben Product Discovery durchführen: Kundengespräche, Research, Validierung von Ideen - unterstützt durch gängige KI-Tools Business Cases kalkulieren und bewerten Anforderungen strukturiert schreiben (Requirements, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria) Rapid Prototyping mit KI-Tools, um Ideen schnell visualisierbar und testbar zu machen Umsetzung gemeinsam mit interner und externer IT begleiten Weiterentwicklung und Umsetzung der bestehenden Product Roadmap Alle neuen Features und Optimierungen konsequent auf KPIs ausrichten Professionalisierung des Produktzahlenwerks in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem bereits bestehenden BI-Team (Basis an Zahlen ist vorhanden, das Framework muss geschärft werden) Enge Verzahnung mit dem Marketing-Team, das über Automatisierung und E-Mail-Kampagnen kontinuierlich Leads generiert Unterstützung der Geschäftsführung bei der Erarbeitung einer übergreifenden Produktstrategie Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung eines funktionierenden Product-Tribes Identifikation, Bewertung und Umsetzung neuer Produkt- und Business-Cases Qualifikation Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Product Management (Mid–Senior Level) mit B2B-SaaS-Produkten (wir sind rein B2B), idealerweise mit historisch gewachsenen Plattformen Hands-on Mindset: Du führst Discovery selbst durch, sprichst mit Kunden, schreibst Anforderungen und bleibst bis in die Umsetzung dran Routinierter Einsatz gängiger KI-Tools in der Produktarbeit - von Discovery-Unterstützung bis Rapid Prototyping Sicherer Umgang mit Zahlen: KPI-Definition, datengetriebene Priorisierung, Zusammenarbeit mit BI-Teams Fähigkeit, Struktur in komplexe, unsaubere Setups zu bringen Souveräner Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern - insbesondere Marketing, IT und Geschäftsführung Mindset: Professionalisieren und weiterentwickeln statt verwalten Legal Tech Erfahrung ist ein Plus - aber kein Muss. Benefits Ein dynamisches Team mit Zusammenhalt und offener Kommunikation Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege Gründliches Onboarding und individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten Modernes Büro in Berlin-Charlottenburg (Nähe Ku’damm) Kostenlose Snacks, Suppen, Kaffee, Limonaden und Wasser Regelmäßige Team-Events und lockere Get-togethers Leistungsgerechte Vergütung Warum sich die Rolle lohnt Echter Gestaltungsspielraum - Keine vorgefertigten Produktprozesse. Deine Arbeit definiert, wie Product bei uns funktioniert. Direkter Einfluss auf Strategie - Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung und gestaltest die Ausrichtung unserer Produkte aktiv mit. Substanz statt PowerPoint - Reale Produkte, Kunden, Umsätze und eine Datenbasis - du baust darauf auf, nicht ins Leere. Datenbasis vorhanden - BI-Team und Grunddaten stehen. Jetzt geht es darum, daraus ein professionalisiertes KPI-Framework zu machen. Breites Spielfeld - SaaS, Legal, Consulting, interne Tools - keine eindimensionale Produktwelt. Verantwortung, die ihrem Namen gerecht wird - Entscheidungen bleiben nicht theoretisch. Sie wirken. Rahmenbedingungen Vollzeit bevorzugt, Teilzeit möglich Hybrid: Homeoffice möglich, aber regelmäßige Präsenz im Büro gewünscht Klingt nach dir? Dann lass uns sprechen. Kein aufwendiger Prozess, kein Buzzword-Interview. Wir wollen verstehen, wie du denkst - und ob du Lust hast, hier wirklich etwas aufzubauen. Schreib uns einfach kurz, wer du bist und woran du zuletzt gearbeitet hast.
title: Product Manager (m/w/d)

description: Ce qui vous attend Au sein du pôle Communication, Marketing & Customer Experience de Baloise Assurances Luxembourg, et plus particulièrement de l’équipe Marketing, vous contribuez activement au développement de notre présence digitale, à la performance de nos actions marketing et à l’amélioration de l’expérience de nos clients, partenaires et agents. Votre rôle se situe au croisement de plusieurs expertises : Marketing, Communication et Customer Experience . Vous travaillerez ainsi dans l’équipe marketing en étroite collaboration avec notamment la responsable Customer Experience et l’équipe Communication afin de garantir la cohérence entre nos campagnes, nos contenus, nos parcours digitaux et l’expérience réellement proposée à nos clients . · concevoir, déployer et optimiser des campagnes d’acquisition multicanales : SEA, Social Ads, SEO et Display ; · mettre en place et assurer le suivi du tracking et de l’attribution marketing à l’aide de Google Tag Manager, Wizaly et Google Analytics ; · déployer et piloter la stratégie de Local SEO via Uberall sur l’ensemble du réseau d’agences ; · suivre la performance des campagnes , analyser leur retour sur investissement et mettre en place des actions d’optimisation continue ; · créer, gérer et optimiser les landing pages et parcours de conversion , en collaboration avec la Customer Experience, afin de concilier performance commerciale, simplicité et qualité de l’expérience utilisateur ; · contribuer, avec la Customer Experience, à l’analyse des parcours digitaux, points de friction et comportements utilisateurs , et traduire ces enseignements en pistes d’amélioration concrètes ; · veiller au respect des exigences liées au RGPD, à la gestion du consentement et aux politiques cookies ; · Définir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie digitale de Baloise Luxembourg, en cohérence avec les objectifs commerciaux, Marketing, Communication et Customer Experience de l’entreprise ; · gérer le budget dédié aux activités digitales et assurer un suivi régulier des investissements et de leur performance ; · accompagner les agents et les équipes internes dans leurs initiatives et besoins en marketing digital ; · définir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie éditoriale de Facebook et Instagram , en coordination avec la Communication afin de garantir la cohérence des messages, des contenus et de l’image de marque sur l’ensemble de nos canaux ; · suivre les tendances, innovations et évolutions des pratiques en marketing digital afin d’identifier de nouvelles opportunités pour Baloise Luxembourg ; · collaborer avec les équipes internes, les agences et les partenaires externes afin de garantir la bonne réalisation des projets et campagnes. Ce que nous attendons · Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme Bac +5 en marketing, communication, digital, e-commerce ou domaine similaire ; · Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français et l’anglais. La connaissance du luxembourgeois ou de l’allemand constitue un atout ; · Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée en marketing digital, idéalement dans un environnement orienté acquisition et performance ; · Vous maîtrisez les principaux leviers du marketing digital : SEA, SEO, Social Ads, Display, analytics et conversion ; · Vous avez une expérience pratique de Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager et, idéalement, de Wizaly ; · Vous maîtrisez les enjeux liés au tracking, à l’attribution, à l’analyse de la performance et à l’optimisation des campagnes ; · Vous êtes à l’aise avec la création et l’optimisation de landing pages et de parcours de conversion ; · Vous connaissez les réseaux sociaux, la création de contenus et l’animation de communautés ; · Vous disposez de connaissances en RGPD, gestion des cookies et consentement digital ;
title: Chargé.e de Marketing Digital

description: NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now. Overview We are seeking a Techno-Functional Business Analyst with strong banking domain knowledge and hands-on experience in APIs and database technologies. The ideal candidate will bridge business requirements and technical solutions, ensuring seamless integration and data flow across banking systems. Key Responsibilities Requirement Gathering & Analysis Collaborate with business stakeholders to capture functional and technical requirements for banking applications. Conduct workshops to elicit functional needs for banking products and systems. Document User Stories with clear Functional and technical and specifications. Analyze and map current banking processes (e.g., credit, payments, retail/corporate banking), identify inefficiencies, and propose automation enhancements. API Integration & Management Coordinate with development teams for API implementation and integration with banking systems. Validate API payloads, endpoints, and security compliance. Database & Data Analysis Perform SQL queries for data validation, reconciliation, and reporting. Support data migration, ETL processes, and ensure data integrity across systems. Analyze data flows and create data mapping documents. Agile Product Backlog Management Write user stories, prioritize backlog, coordinate sprints, and manage tickets using Agile tools like JIRA and Confluence System Testing & Quality Assurance Support SIT, UAT, and regression testing for API and database-related functionalities. Use tools like Postman, Swagger for API testing and validation. Stakeholder Communication Act as a liaison between business users and technical teams. Provide technical insights during solution design and architecture discussions. Compliance & Documentation Ensure adherence to banking regulations and security standards. Maintain detailed documentation for APIs, data models, and integration workflows. Required Skills An experienced IT professional with 8+ years, a proven track record in banking and delivery of IT enabled change Banking domain expertise (Customer, Retail, Corporate, Payments, Lending). Understanding of APIs (REST, SOAP) and API testing tools (Postman etc). Proficiency in SQL and relational databases (Oracle, MS SQL). Familiarity with data mapping, ETL processes, and data governance. Experience with Agile methodologies (JIRA, Confluence). Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Be expert in the use of Web based technologies and Agile /Waterfall project management methodologies. Have excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or Finance. Certifications: CBAP, Agile, or API-related certifications About NTT DATA NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D. Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com, @nttdatafed.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us. NTT DATA endeavors to make https://us.nttdata.com accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us. This contact information is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. description: Als Performance Marketeer Nieuwbouw geef jij vorm aan hoe mensen nieuwbouwprojecten van VORM ontdekken en uiteindelijk kiezen om er te gaan wonen. Met vrijheid om te experimenteren en eigenaarschap over je eigen aanpak, maak je iedere campagne slimmer dan de vorige. Een functie voor wie nieuwsgierig is en liever zelf aan de slag gaat dan lang te vergaderen over het perfecte plan. Wat ga je doen? Als Performance Marketeer Nieuwbouw zorg jij ervoor dat onze nieuwbouwprojecten niet alleen gezien worden, maar ook verkocht. Bij VORM begint de verkoop namelijk niet wanneer de eerste woning online staat. Die begint maanden eerder. Met de verhalen die we vertellen, de beelden die we laten zien, de community die we bouwen én de campagnes die jij bedenkt. Mensen moeten niet alleen denken: "Mooi project." Maar vooral: "Hier wil ik straks wonen.". Van de eerste teaser tot de laatste verkochte woning, jij lanceert complete nieuwe woonwijken. En dat niet voor één project, maar voor ongeveer 50 nieuwbouwprojecten per jaar. De online zichtbaarheid én performance van onze projecten liggen in jouw handen. Campagnes bedenken, bouwen, analyseren en continu optimaliseren, dat is waar jij goed in wordt. Daarbij werk je onder andere met Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio en Meta Business Suite. Natuurlijk zet je ook AI slim in. Zie jij een nieuwe tool of techniek waarmee we slimmer, sneller of creatiever kunnen werken? Dan horen we dat graag. Ook het beheer van forse online advertentiebudgetten hoort bij jouw rol, waarbij jij bepaalt waar iedere euro het meeste rendement oplevert. Geen campagne, doelgroep of dag is hetzelfde. Na ongeveer een jaar hopen we dat jij kunt zeggen: onze campagnes converteren beter; onze cost per lead is gedaald; we halen meer kwalitatieve inschrijvingen binnen; onze online marketing is slimmer geworden; onze nieuwbouwprojecten verkopen sneller. Bij VORM krijg je geen dichtgetimmerd draaiboek. Je krijgt vertrouwen. Zie jij kansen op TikTok? Probeer het. Denk je dat AI onze campagnes slimmer kan maken? Laten we het testen. Heb jij een goed idee waarvoor budget nodig is? Dan luisteren we graag. We geloven namelijk dat de beste ideeën vaak ontstaan bij mensen die nieuwsgierig genoeg zijn om iets nieuws uit te proberen. Dit ben jij Misschien werk je nu bij een marketingbureau. Misschien ben je net afgestudeerd. Misschien heb je al enkele jaren ervaring of beheer je in je vrije tijd campagnes voor jezelf of anderen. Voor ons is dat minder belangrijk dan jouw instelling. Jij wordt enthousiast van online marketing en wilt iedere campagne slimmer maken dan de vorige. Je hebt affiniteit met Meta Ads, Google Ads en TikTok, gebruikt data om betere keuzes te maken en bent nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe technologieën en AI. Daarnaast: neem je initiatief en eigenaarschap; experimenteer je graag en durf je nieuwe ideeën te testen; leer je graag en wil je jezelf continu ontwikkelen; werk je graag samen in een ambitieus team. Bij VORM werken we hard, lachen we veel en houden we de lijnen kort. We nemen snel beslissingen en geloven dat je meer leert door iets uit te proberen dan door er weken over te vergaderen. Fouten maken mag. Sterker nog: experimenteren zit in ons DNA. Je bouwt niet aan losse campagnes voor steeds weer een andere klant. Je bouwt mee aan één sterk merk én aan tientallen nieuwbouwprojecten waar duizenden mensen straks wonen, leven en hun kinderen zien opgroeien. Je ziet jouw campagnes terug in echte buurten. In verkochte woningen. In blije kopers. Dat maakt jouw werk iedere dag zichtbaar én betekenisvol. We zoeken geen extra handjes, maar iemand die eigenaar wil worden van onze online marketing. Iemand die nieuwsgierig is, initiatief neemt en onze campagnes steeds een stap beter maakt. Denk jij tijdens het lezen van deze vacature al meerdere keren: "Dat zou ik anders aanpakken." Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Wat bieden we jou? Een markt overstijgend salaris dat meegroeit met jouw ontwikkeling, een top pensioenregeling voor later en extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid; 35 vakantiedagen op basis van een fulltime dienstverband; Een goede werk privébalans dankzij een flexibel werkbeleid en soepele regelingen voor arbeidsduur, werktijden, calamiteiten, mantelzorg of sabbatical; Flexibel werken, buiten de deur voor afspraken, vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Rotterdam, maar ook vanuit onze dependances in Den Haag en Amsterdam; Bij VORM staat fulltime gelijk aan 38,75 uur per week; Thuiswerken is mogelijk, maar de connectie met je collega's en ons kantoor is key; Ook jij blijft jezelf ontwikkelen met onze VORM masterclasses en een ruim opleidingsbudget van € 3.000,00 per jaar voor jouw professionele groei; Borrels, bokstrainingen en vastgoedclubs, we zorgen voor genoeg inspiratie en plezier; VORM voor de stad: maatschappelijke impact door projecten zoals koken voor ouderen. Bij VORM werken we hard, maar we vinden het minstens zo belangrijk om samen te genieten. Denk aan een gezellige zomer BBQ of even ontspannen met een stoelmassage. En wil je iets extra’s doen voor het goede doel? Sluit je dan aan bij ons enthousiaste Roparun team.
title: Performance Marketeer Nieuwbouw

description: Dit breng jij mee Als junior B2C analist bij VodafoneZiggo zet jij onze omvangrijke databronnen om in waardevolle inzichten waar collega’s direct mee aan de slag kunnen. Je onderzoekt klantgedrag, product prestaties of marketinginitiatieven, signaleert waar het beter kan en helpt collega’s om samen onze producten, processen en klantbeleving steeds verder te verbeteren. Wij werken binnen het team van twaalf analisten voor verschillende B2C business units zoals Ziggo, Vodafone & hollandsnieuwe. Je bent nieuwsgierig en resultaatgericht, en je vertaalt complexe data naar praktische inzichten die de business direct sterker maken. Je neemt graag initiatief, werkt goed samen en communiceert helder met collega’s. Je bent commercieel, klantgericht, planmatig en je analytisch vermogen helpt je om optimaal te presteren in een dynamische omgeving. Je kunt omgaan met financiële en operationele data die je uit verschillende databronnen haalt en vertaalt tot inzichtelijke rapporten en presentaties op basis waarvan de verschillende commerciële teams en het B2C leadership keuzes kunnen maken. Dit breng je mee Minimaal een hbo werk- en denk niveau, met een opleiding in Econometrie, Data Analytics, Data Science, of andere studie met een sterke kwantitatieve basis; Een flinke dosis aan kennis op het gebied van data & analytics: van basis statistiek tot aan modelbouw; Ervaring met data analyse tools, bij voorkeur Python en SQL; Sterke communicatie- en presentatievaardigheden in zowel de Nederlandse als de Engelse taal. Je bent analytisch, proactief en resultaatgericht Gaat dit over jou Je bent analytisch Hoofd- of bijzaak? Dat verschil zie jij meteen. Je komt makkelijk tot de kern en houdt tegelijk het overzicht. Je bent klantgericht Klant blij, jij blij. Je rust niet voordat iemands probleem is opgelost, stelt de juiste vragen en kunt goed luisteren. Je vindt altijd een oplossing Je zet problemen om in kansen. Je onderzoekt ze grondig en hebt een scherp oog voor het inzichtelijk maken van mogelijke oorzaken. Je bent part of the team Jij bent een sociaal dier en doet moeite voor je collega's. Ook als je daarvoor je eigen belangen opzij moet zetten. Je neemt initiatief Afwachten? Niks voor jou. Wanneer er een keuze nodig is, beslis je snel en doordacht. Je past je makkelijk aan Loopt een project anders dan gepland? Jij blijft kalm en verzint snel een nieuwe oplossing. description: Job Description The Product Owner is responsible for the delivery and support of products and functionality within the product line. They are responsible for ensuring that the road map for their product is broken down into Epics, and Stories that a held in a backlog and that are prioritized for delivery by the product team. Acting as the voice of the customer to the product team this role ensures that the customers’ expectations are met and managed through planning, execution, and sprint playbacks to the business. Lead and support the product team in sprint playbacks to ensure that business expectations are met, and the delivery is aligned to the business requirements. Support and lead the team in sprint retrospectives so that impediments encountered during the sprint cycle are not repeated, and that the process is continually improved so that the team's velocity is maximized without impacting quality. Responsible for discovering innovative product solutions that deliver the necessary value, are usable by the target audience, and can be delivered with the available resources in the required time frame. Impediments that are found during the development process will be resolved by the Product owner who will escalate or seek business input to ensure the team's development velocity is not slowed while ensuring that the business expectations are still met. The product owner is the subject matter expert for their products who can advise the business on their suitability for the requirements and advocate for the value they deliver. Responsibilities KEY RESONSIBILITIES Partner with Product Managers in developing the Product Strategy and advancing the HBT Strategic Digital Goals Conduct product planning, design and quality of releases for the Digital Valuestream Plan, and groom the product backlog so that each sprint is prioritized to offer the best value in the shortest possible delivery time. Acting as the voice of the business to the product team and a key path to resolving impediments raised by the team. Find new innovative product solutions through procurement or development to deliver the necessary business value. Ensure all items meet the definition of ready before they are entered into a sprint e.g., sized, stories complete, acceptance criteria agreed etc. Ensure all items meet the definition of done before they are included in the sprint demo Present and demo features and functionality to leaders and large organizations. Identifying challenges and opportunities to improve the agile process and the effectiveness of the product team. Be a vocal advocate for the team and promote its activities and successes Work closely with leadership and several cross-functional teams to develop and deliver innovative consumer software and services Represent the voice of the customer and champion needs of the business and key stakeholders in defining use cases and subsequent user stories Ensure customer and product requirements are collected from the field and documented Define user stories, including the right level of detail, such that each user story guarantees proper acceptance criteria is met upon delivery. Planning, grooming and prioritization of user stories as preparation for Sprints and Releases Articulate details, prioritize backlog and guide the development process, ensuring all parties are working together to deliver the right solution Analyze customer feedback and usage metrics to identify key pain points Deliver solutions that are long-term, large-scale and require vision, creativity, innovation, advanced analytical and inductive thinking Drive requirement definition, customer experience design, product roadmap and prioritization Partner with HBT teams to understand their customer needs and influence adoption of new services Manage bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make trade-offs, balance the business needs versus technical constraints, and maximize business benefit while building great customer experiences. Qualifications QUALIFICATIONS Proven experience working in an Agile/Scrum and Lean environment in a Product Owner role. Excellent competency in product/project management tools Ability to synthesize user feedback and data to make data driven decisions. Ability to prioritize across competing priorities and juggle several work streams with multiple stakeholders Bachelor's Degree 5+ years of experience in product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology Experience with end-to-end product delivery Experience overseeing roadmap strategy and definition Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product YOU MUST HAVE Excellent verbal and written communication skills Sharp analytical and quantitative skills while the ability to use data and metrics to back up assumptions, recommendations, and drive actions Strong strategic aptitude; ability to define a winning business strategy and product road map, and execute complex product development cycles Excellent customer experience intuition; demonstrated success in inventing innovative and user-friendly products Executive presence to influence teams and leaders at all levels Identify and resolve issues that may impair the team's ability to meet strategic, financial, and/or technical goals Experience developing technology solutions in a fast-paced environment WE VALUE Understanding of key information technology solutions and practices Strong business acumen and ability to translate new technology into business value Creation of result-oriented Management Operating System Effectively demonstrates ability to deliver on complex situations or problems Creative and collaborative problem solving capability Conveys specific, observable, and measurable expectations for each assignment Driving "fast and right" results in a matrixed environment Consistently makes timely decisions even in the face of complexity About Us Honeywell helps organizations solve the world's most complex challenges in automation, the future of aviation and energy transition. As a trusted partner, we provide actionable solutions and innovation through our Aerospace Technologies, Building Automation, Energy and Sustainability Solutions, and Industrial Automation business segments – powered by our Honeywell Forge software – that help make the world smarter, safer and more sustainable.

description: Bijna 5 miljoen mensen gebruiken onze patiëntenomgeving en meer dan de helft van alle huisartsen in Nederland werkt met onze producten. We bouwen in hoog tempo aan een platform dat de zorg beter maakt voor de patiënt en de zorgverlener. Als Online & Growth Marketeer bij HCI UZO ben jij de performance-expert van het label. Jij meet en verbetert alles wat we online naar buiten brengen en bouwt mee aan een funnel die zichzelf laat schalen. Wat ga je doen? UZO maakt het patiëntportaal en de website waarmee huisartsenpraktijken hun patiënten digitaal helpen. Jouw doel is meetbaar meer bereik en conversie en een funnel die stap voor stap automatischer wordt. Online campagnes voorbereiden, uitvoeren en analyseren (SEA, social advertising en display). Website en landingspagina’s optimaliseren met SEO en A/B-testen. Groeihypotheses formuleren en experimenten opzetten over de hele funnel. Samen met de marketeer pijnpunten van praktijken in kaart brengen en de juiste content aanbieden. Meebouwen aan een geautomatiseerde funnel volgens product-led growth. Dashboards bouwen en onderhouden met HubSpot, Google Analytics en Search Console. AI-tooling slim inzetten voor analyses, contentvarianten en klantfeedback. Inzichten uit experimenten actief delen met collega’s van product, onboarding en sales. Jouw taken: Groei in gekwalificeerd verkeer en online leads Conversieratio’s op website en landingspagina’s Aantal en kwaliteit van experimenten en het percentage dat wordt opgeschaald Mate van automatisering in de funnel Over ons Bij Health Cloud Initiative (HCI) werken ruim 250 collega’s aan één doel: betere zorg, makkelijk geregeld. Bij UZO werken we aan technologie die écht helpt: voor de zorgverlener én voor de gebruiker. Dat doen we in een open en betrokken team met hoge ambities en een eerlijke cultuur. Jouw experimenten bepalen straks hoe snel we die ambities waarmaken. Je werkt nauw samen met de marketeer van UZO. Die bewaakt het merk en de content; jij bent verantwoordelijk voor de performance. Samen vormen jullie het marketingduo van het label. Je rapporteert aan de commercieel verantwoordelijke van UZO en maakt daarnaast deel uit van het centrale Growth Marketing Team van HCI. Daar deel je kennis, tooling en best practices met de marketeers van de andere labels. De lijnen met de business zijn kort. Bovendien ligt er al een stevige experimenteerbasis: je voorganger heeft honderden A/B-testen uitgevoerd, waardoor je niet vanaf nul hoeft te beginnen. Je krijgt de ruimte om te testen en collega’s van product, onboarding en support zijn altijd dichtbij. Wat bieden we jou? Salaris van € 4.000 tot € 4.500 bruto per maand 8% vakantiegeld, internetvergoeding en goede pensioenregeling Hybride werken in Amsterdam-Zuidoost en vanuit huis 24 vakantiedagen en mogelijkheid om feestdagen om te ruilen Reiskostenvergoeding en thuiswerkplekvergoeding Persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget van € 1.000 Collegiaal team met hart voor zorg en technologie Dagelijks vers fruit, samen lunchen en teamuitjes Werken bij de marktleider in zorg-IT met impact op schaal Wat breng jij mee? Hbo werk- en denkniveau (online marketing of commerciële economie) 3 tot 5 jaar ervaring in online of growth marketing Aantoonbaar resultaat in SEA, SEO en conversie-optimalisatie Ruime ervaring met A/B-testen en marketing automation (bij voorkeur HubSpot) NIMA B Digital Marketing of HubSpot-certificering is een pre Begrip van product-led growth en funnel-automatisering Sterke inhoudelijke communicatie richting een kritische doelgroep Interesse? Wil jij jouw growth skills inzetten voor betere zorg? Stuur je cv naar vacatures@hci-software.com en we nemen snel contact met je op. Het sollicitatieproces We bekijken je sollicitatie zorgvuldig. Bij een match volgt een eerste gesprek met een van onze teamleden. In een tweede gesprek ontmoet je je toekomstige collega’s. Klikt het van beide kanten? Dan doen we je een aanbod. Let op: acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

description: At Visteon, the work we do is both relevant and recognized—not just by our organization, but by our peers, by industry-leading brands, and by millions of drivers around the world. That’s YOUR work. And, as a truly global technology leader in the mobility space, focused on building cross-functional AND cross-cultural teams, we connect you with people who help you grow. So here, whatever we do is not a job. It’s a mission. As a multi-billion-dollar leader of disruptive change in the industry, we are shaping the future, while enabling a cleaner environment. No other industry offers more fast-paced change and opportunity. We are in the midst of a mobility revolution that will completely change the way we interact with our vehicles, reduce the number of car accidents and fatalities, and make the world a cleaner place. Visteon is at the epicenter of this mobility revolution. Two major trends in the automotive industry – the shift to electric vehicles and vehicles with autonomous safety technologies – have created unique opportunities for Visteon. We are the only automotive provider focused exclusively on cockpit electronics – the fastest-growing segment in the industry. Qualification, Experience and Skills: Technical Product Owner for Infotainment in Automotive Domain Automotive Infotainment experience of minimum 10 years in the field of IVI technologies Shall have Strong experience as Feature Owner / Product Owner with Good Technical Background Shall have strong Expertise in managing product backlogs and prioritizing customer needs. Shall have Activities at Customer Locations like leading the workshop on feature plan/ technical camps / Delivery workshops. Shall have rich Working experience with Scrum and Agile methodology. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, software engineering, or related field. 10+ years of experience with software development, infrastructure development, or development and operations related to embedded projects. Experience with Developing software for Renesas or similar micro controllers. Experience in development languages like C, C++, and others Experience in development of CAN & Diagnostics , Audio DSP SW etc Good interpersonal skills and communication with all levels of management. Able to multitask, prioritize, and manage time efficiently. What you will do: Represents the customer, interfaces, and engages the customer (PDTL/Program Manager/PSL/OEM). Creates and manages software Feature Implementation Plan with product level plan. Creates and maintains the Software Product Backlog. Manages external (customer DCRs) and internal change requests through software backlog items. Prioritizes and sequences the software backlog items according to product level timing plan. Works with systems team, design champion/software architect to create Epics and converts them into stories that are granular enough to be achieved in a single sprint along with acceptance criteria. Ensures stories are made clear to the scrum team and requirements related impediments are resolved on time in coordination with systems requirements team. Negotiates budget requirements / expectations with the program management in consultation with the Technical Delivery Manager(s). Supports Technical Delivery Manager(s) to define lower-level sprint plans in alignment with project level plans. Nice to have: Experience with CI/CD tools, Configuration Management, and/or experience with installing, Experience participating in Scrum/Kanban, Agile workflow methodologies. Certified Agile Product Owner/ Scrum Master. More Good Reasons to Work for Visteon Focusing on the Future Our company strategy focuses on leading the evolution of automotive digital cockpits and safety solutions. This strategy is driven by constant innovation, and you will support our efforts through your role. We are recognized across the industry for innovation. We have a strong book of business that is expected to drive future growth, along with a customer base that includes almost every automotive manufacturer in the world. Company Culture Working at Visteon is a journey in which our employees can develop their strengths and advance their careers while making a difference globally. Join us and help change the world and how we interact with our vehicles. Visteon is where the best technical talent creates the future. Learn more about our culture here. About Visteon Visteon is advancing mobility through innovative technology solutions that enable a software-defined future. Our state-of-the-art product portfolio merges digital cockpit innovations, advanced displays, AI-enhanced software solutions, and integrated EV architecture solutions. With expertise spanning passenger vehicles, commercial transportation, and two-wheelers, Visteon partners with global automakers to create safer, cleaner, and more connected journeys. Headquartered in Van Buren Township, Michigan, Visteon operates in 17 countries, employing a global network of innovation centers and manufacturing facilities. In 2024, we recorded annual sales of approximately $3.87 billion and secured $6.1 billion in new business.

description: We’re looking for a Performance & Growth Lead to define how our marketing efforts translate into measurable impact. This is not a hands-on execution role. You will define and lead performance strategies within the broader marketing direction, guide execution, and ensure we continuously improve outcomes across regions and channels, strengthening how marketing contributes to broader business outcomes and attracts and converts high-quality talent. We’re investing in how we show up to the world, to do that effectively; we need to be sharper in how we translate strategy into measurable impact. This role is central to making that happen. What You'll Do Define performance strategy Translate business and hiring priorities into a clear multi-channel growth approach Define how channels contribute across the funnel (awareness → conversion) Define channel roles, investment logic, and optimisation frameworks Bring structure to how paid and organic efforts work together Own performance outcomes Define and own global performance KPIs, with accountability for both volume and quality of results Turn performance data into clear decisions and priorities, identifying and scaling opportunities for improvement across channels and regions Own execution quality (via teams and partners) Set direction for investment, campaign approach, and optimisation, ensuring high-quality execution across paid channels Raise capability and consistency across teams through clear standards, frameworks, and best practices Lead agencies Set direction for media and performance partners, challenging plans and holding agencies accountable for results Define measurement direction (with you) Ensure performance is measured against meaningful business outcomes, partnering on tracking, dashboards, and data quality. Leverage performance insights to inform content, campaigns, and website optimisation Drive consistency across regions Establish performance principles and guardrails, raising the standard of performance marketing across teams and regions Who You Are 8 - 12 years in performance marketing, growth or demand generation Strong experience across paid channels, with a strategic, not execution-only lens Proven track record of owning performance outcomes Experience leading agencies and driving execution through others Strong analytical thinking, you turn data into decisions, not just reports, with a solid understanding of measurement, tracking, attribution, and their inherent limitations Experience working across multiple markets or stakeholder groups You’re comfortable in environments where not everything is fully defined yet and you know how to bring structure without slowing things down. You are accountable for how campaigns are structured, optimised, and improved, and you stay close enough to the work to ensure quality You bring a commercial and marketing lens beyond martech or analytics infrastructure You actively lead and challenge agencies instead of managing them passive Who We Are At Optiver, our mission is to constantly improve the market by injecting liquidity, providing accurate pricing, increasing transparency and acting as a stabilizing force no matter the market conditions. With a focus on continuous improvement, we participate in the safeguarding of healthy and efficient markets for everyone who participates. As one of the largest market making institutions, we are a trusted partner of 70+ exchanges across the globe. What You'll Get You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, where you’ll be surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem solvers. Motivated by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high-performing environment alongside talented colleagues, working collectively to tackle the toughest problems in the financial markets. In addition, you’ll receive: A performance-based bonus structure unmatched anywhere in the industry. We combine our profits across desks, teams and offices into a global profit pool. The opportunity to work alongside best-in-class professionals from over 50 different countries. 25 paid vacation days in your first year, increasing to 30 from your second year onwards. Training opportunities, discounts on health insurance, and fully paid first-class commuting expenses. Extensive office perks, including breakfast, lunch and dinner, world-class barista coffee, in-house physio and chair massages, organized sports and leisure activities, and Friday afternoon drinks. Training and continuous learning opportunities, including access to conferences and tech events. Competitive relocation packages and visa sponsorship where necessary for expats. How To Apply Apply directly via the form below. If you have any questions feel free to contact our Recruitment team via our recruitment inquiry form . Please note: We do not require any assistance from third-parties including agencies in the recruitment of this role We cannot accept applications via email DIVERSITY STATEMENT Optiver is committed to diversity and inclusion .

description: Job Description Ready to leverage your analytical sharpness to turn raw data into the engine behind our growth? Are you ambitious, equipped with razor-sharp analytical skills, and eager to be the ultimate link between Data, Finance, and the business? If so, we are looking for you! Your Contribution to the Adventure We stand on the brink of a massive growth acceleration and are fully steering toward healthy, predictable SaaS growth. As a BI Analyst, you will be part of our data team and build the foundation upon which the entire company makes its decisions: reliable metrics, sharp insights, and forecasts that Finance and managers can truly lean on. We are looking for someone capable of answering abstract questions and providing them with interpretation and direction. You define what a number really means. What does this entail? Ownership & SaaS Metrics: In this role, you will own our core SaaS metrics (ARR, NRR, churn, CAC/LTV & payback period), their corresponding definitions, and dashboards. Strategic Collaboration: You will interface directly with our 'heads of' (such as Finance and Data) to translate their questions into concrete analyses, and you will support business cases, forecasting, and scenario analyses as a finance-minded data analyst. Data Governance & Pipelines: You will ensure that every business-critical number has a single owner and a single definition. Alongside this steering role, you will modernize and maintain relevant reporting pipelines on the Databricks platform and automate analyses that answer recurring questions. Manageable Growth: You will work right in the middle of our company scaling phase: while we accelerate as an organization, you will deliver the figures and insights that keep that growth manageable and profitable. A True Connector: You are a true connector when it comes to execution and communication: you collaborate seamlessly with Finance, Sales, and CS, and translate complex data into clear, compelling stories. Sven’s tip for new 12Builders: “Finding your own style and using it to inspire your colleagues is strongly encouraged!” Who is 12Build? With a healthy dose of Drive, Openness and Happiness, we are building a transparent construction sector. We are not only a SaaS platform that connects construction companies and promotes collaboration, we are also the market leader in the Netherlands. We have been around for almost twenty years and we are still growing. Our team now consists of more than 90 colleagues, working together from two offices and various home offices throughout Europe. A large part of the construction world in the Benelux, Germany and Denmark already works on our platform and uses our software on a daily basis. And we have the ambition to conquer the whole of Europe! Our Stack & Tools Within our data team, we are continuously expanding our toolkit with reliable data, sharp insights, and the latest AI and cloud technologies. We work with, among other things: Data Platform & Processing: Databricks, PySpark, Python, and MySQL BI & Visualization: Tableau for dashboards and reporting with SaaS and finance metrics (ARR, NRR, churn, margin) as the common thread. Additionally, Amplitude & UserPilot. Customer Data & Tracking: Segment (CDP) as the central source for segmentation and behavioral data. Collaboration: Linear, Confluence, and Slack. Job Requirements What We Expect from You An experienced BI / data analyst with a clear vision for translating data into financial and operational decisions. Deep experience with SQL, Databricks, and PySpark, as well as building clear dashboards and reports in BI tooling. Demonstrated knowledge of SaaS performance metrics (ARR, NRR, churn, CAC/LTV, gross margin) and financial steering / business control within a SaaS environment. A proactive Analyst who takes ownership of recurring reporting tasks (such as safeguarding metric definitions, ensuring data quality, maintaining dashboards, and supporting quarterly business reviews). Analytically minded, flexible, eager to learn, and always up-to-date with the latest developments. A minimum of 3-5 years of experience in data/BI analysis, preferably within a SaaS environment. What We Offer You A starting salary between €4.800 and €5.800 gross per month (based on a senior job level). A 'Lease a Bike' scheme with a €10 monthly employer contribution. A home office allowance for the days you work from home. Free lunch at our office in Nijverdal. 30 vacation days per year. An exciting role within a growing, international SaaS scale-up. Flexible work options (hybrid setup: both from home and the office). Regular team events and ample opportunities for personal and professional development. Choose your own hardware: Windows, Mac, or Linux—everything is possible. Working in an organisation where culture really is number one. Read here how we do that. No towering hierarchical layers. Just a flat organisation with short lines of communication, which makes things easy. You've taken the time to read this text all the way through. That says it all, right? So feel free to apply! Do you have any questions or are you still a little unsure? No problem! Feel free to send an email to Niels (Recruiter, n.jordens@12build.com ). See you soon!
